items.title: Hacker Exploits Critical PHP2Shell Flaws to Win $2,000 Bitcoin Challenge, Releases PoC
items.description: A security researcher known online as killa has won a public Bitcoin challenge by using two critical PHP flaws to reach a test server. The winning run took 19.28 hours. The prize pot was 0.02511679 BTC, worth $2,021.22 at the time of the win on October 25, 2026, at 15:47 UTC. items.title: PHP2Shell Exploitation Attempts Continue Amid Suspected N. Korea Global Scanning Activity
items.description: In an update, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 said it's retracting its earlier assessment that the post-compromise activity targeting the European government agency involved the exploitation of the PHP2Shell flaws. "What researchers saw was an attack against a European government agency executed in the context of a vulnerable PHP application," a spokesperson for the company told The Hacker News via
